name: Campingplatz Bergheimat
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Bergheimat in Bad Hindelang is located in the Allgäuer Alpen, near the border with Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by wooded slopes and the region's typical mountain landscape. Hiking trails and mountain bike routes start directly at the site. The ski areas in the surrounding area, such as Oberjoch or the Nebelhorn, can be reached within a short drive. The facilities include a sanitary building with showers and toilets as well as a common room. The pitches are designed for motorhomes, caravans, and tents and have electricity connections. Guests can expect a peaceful stay with direct access to alpine nature.
